summary: Library advocates oppose cutting E‑Rate funding for library internet connectivity, arguing it would deny essential access for students and job seekers.

claims.argument: Cutting library E‑Rate funding would deny essential internet access for students and job seekers who lack home connectivity.
claims.evidence_quote: Please do not cut funding to libraries for reduced rates for internet connectivity.  Not everyone has access at home.  Some people need it for homework, job searches, etc.  We need to keep this
